summary:
Results-driven Senior Backend Software Developer with 9+ years of expertise in enterprise backend architecture and development. Proven track record of delivering high-performance, scalable backend solutions in fintech and enterprise systems. Core competencies include:

• Back-End Development: Expert in Java (Spring Boot, Spring Cloud), RESTful APIs, GraphQL, gRPC, WebSocket, Enterprise Integration Patterns
• Microservices Architecture: Design and implementation of distributed systems, service mesh, API gateway patterns
• Database Engineering: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Oracle, MySQL, Redis with performance tuning, optimization, and data modeling
• Message Queues & Event Streaming: Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ for asynchronous processing and event-driven architecture
• DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, CI/CD automation, Monitoring and Analytics
• Security & Compliance: PCI-DSS compliant systems, secure payment processing, authentication and authorization
• Technical Leadership: Led and mentored backend development teams, driving innovation and best practices

Key Achievements:
• Led backend architecture for payment processing platform handling $100M+ annual transactions with 99.99% uptime
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to reduce system response time by 45% through microservices implementation
• Improved backend application performance by 60% through technical optimization and coding best practices
• Optimized database queries and caching strategies reducing latency by 50%
• Implemented secure payment solutions compliant with PCI-DSS standards
